scripts.predev: powershell -command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001,5173,5174,5175 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Ports cleared'"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:init: set PGPASSWORD=postgres && "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe" -U postgres -d mailiq_db -f backend/src/db/schema.sql
